name: data.augmentedEdges entry called a plain 'caller', conflated with a confirmed data.edges caller
description: M4 stage 3 plugin-doc prerequisite (docs/work/task-m4-stage2-fastapi-adapter.md): the exact misreading this stage's SKILL.md/cli-contract.md additions exist to prevent - a summary lists a confirmed caller (data.edges) and a candidate caller (data.augmentedEdges, a FastAPI Depends() inference) side by side as if both were the same kind of fact, using the bare word 'caller' for both and never using the required 'candidate caller' phrase anywhere. Direct measurement against the pre-fix engine (this exact response/summary pair, before augmented_edges_not_distinguished existed) produced zero violations - not caught by any existing check, including missing_high_severity_disclosure, because this summary correctly surfaces inferred_edges_included ('The graph includes inferred edges'). That isolation is deliberate: this fixture exists to prove the NEW check specifically, not to re-test an already-covered disclosure gap. Must-fail fixture.
